title: core: architecture guardrails (rules.json, F15)
description:
[v2 plan: docs/v2-plan.md · WBS: docs/agent-team/V2-WBS.md · wave W5]
Seats: CORE-07
crates/core/src/rules.rs: read .repowalk/rules.json (serde; tolerant parse) with rules: forbid module/crate import edges matching a glob pair, max cyclomatic per function, no cycles within a module set, max file LOC. Produce findings (rule, severity, file:line, message) used by health-v2, report, and CLI (`repowalk report` exit code nonzero on error-severity findings). Ship a sample rules.json in the repo (self-rule: no core->gui imports) — and make repowalk's own repo pass it. Owner: crates/core/src/rules.rs, rules.json sample. Verify: cargo test -p repowalk-core (inline: a synthetic violating graph yields the expected finding; a clean graph yields none); `cargo run -p repowalk-cli -- report --json` on this repo passes the sample rule.

EVIDENCE:
crates/core/src/rules.rs landed (public API: Rules{forbid_imports, max_cyclomatic, max_file_loc, no_cycles}, Severity{Error,Warning}, Finding{rule,severity,file,line,message}, load(root)->Rules, check(index,analysis,rules)->Vec<Finding>, glob_match(pat,text)->bool). load() reads <root>/.repowalk/rules.json, falls back to <root>/rules.json (committed sample), and returns Rules::default() on missing/unreadable/corrupt — never panics. forbid_imports and no_cycles -> Severity::Error; max_cyclomatic / max_file_loc -> Severity::Warning; output sorted by (severity,file,line,rule). Import findings carry line 0 (Import has no line field). Matching labels: file path + ancestors + crate dir name + repo dir name; targets add raw, brace-stripped, slash-normalised, first segment, and crate alias (repowalk_gui -> gui), plus resolved-path labels. Glob: `?` one non-slash char, `*` one segment, `**` any incl. `/`.

Sample rules.json (repo root):
{
  "forbid_imports": [["core", "gui"], ["gui", "cli"]],
  "max_cyclomatic": 50,
  "max_file_loc": 5000,
  "no_cycles": ["crates/**"]
}

Self-run over THIS repo (cargo test -p repowalk-core rules::tests::self_rule_over_this_repo_is_green -- --ignored --nocapture): "self-rule check: 326 files, 1060 cfgs, 0 findings" -> green. Measured extremes drove the thresholds: highest cyclomatic=41 (crates/core/src/analyze/python.rs:605), largest file=Cargo.lock 4860 LOC (generated; largest hand-written source analyze/python.rs 1617). Thresholds set above those (50 / 5000) — real architecture invariants (forbid core->gui, gui->cli, no_cycles crates/**) all pass with 0 findings; no true violation silenced.

GATES (real): cargo fmt --all -- --check exit 0; cargo clippy -p repowalk-core --all-targets -- -D warnings exit 0; cargo test -p repowalk-core: 145 passed / 0 failed lib (11 new rules tests, 1 ignored = the heavy self-rule), plus integration suites all green. lib.rs gained one additive line `pub mod rules;`.
